thread:
deploy-bot: Canary promote for 'session-proxy@2026-09-01' failed verification: expected=sha256:ccddffee got=sha256:ccddef00. Automatic hold engaged.

emily: hitting this during the 30m change window. promote job shows successful fetch from CDN but digest mismatch on verify.

ryan: i inspected CDN edge logs  looks like edge returned a cached partial object (206) for that key right after upload. suspect stale/partial cache served to promote job.

nate: pulled object from origin and edge. origin=sha256:ccddffee, edge=sha256:ccddef00. edge is truncated. this is a caching invalidation race.

infra: we recently rolled a caching agent that toggles background validation TTLs. there was a restart during publish window. im seeing stale objects in a small percentage of edge nodes. opening INFRA-200.

emily: options: 1) pin to last-good 2026-08-31, 2) force-promote ignoring verify (no), 3) flush edge cache then re-run publish/verify. given time constraints, pin seems fastest.

qa: agree pin. We should still flush caches for that key and run a controlled publish+verify to ensure we can promote safely after remediation.

release-manager: agree. pin service-only to avoid blocking unrelated promotes. schedule cache flush and a verified re-publish outside the change window. add ARTIFACT-1750 for follow-up.

deploy-bot: Usage: `deploybot pin --service session-proxy --image 2026-08-31 --reason "edge cache served truncated object 2026-09-01"`

emily: running pin now:
```bash
deploybot pin --service session-proxy --image 2026-08-31 --reason "edge cache served truncated object 2026-09-01"
```

deploy-bot: Pin successful. Canary reverted to 2026-08-31; traffic restored.

infra: flushing edge caches for key=artifacts/session-proxy/v2026-09-01.tar.gz across all POPs now. Will post status when done.

ryan: created ARTIFACT-1750: "edge cache invalidation race causing truncated objects; add publish-time edge-bust, validate-after-finalize, and healthcheck for caching agent restarts". Assigning to @infra and @ryan.

infra: cache flush completed for 97% of POPs; 3% still draining due to node restart. will re-run flush and add a temporary routing bypass for promote jobs.

qa: once flush is confirmed, we'll re-publish the artifact to a temp key, run full verify from multiple regions, and then attempt a canary promote outside the current window.

release-manager: release notes: "Canary for session-proxy (2026-09-01) held due to edge cache serving a truncated artifact; pinned to 2026-08-31 to maintain SLAs. ARTIFACT-1750 / INFRA-200 opened for remediation."

emily: thanks everyone. keeping window open but blocking this particular service. please add any further findings to ARTIFACT-1750.

deploy-bot: Canary promotion status: held -> pinned -> stable (pinned 2026-08-31).

release-manager: final decision: pin applied; no cross-service rollback. postmortem and remediation tracked in ARTIFACT-1750 and INFRA-200. closing thread. :white_check_mark:
